desc: The great canoes of West Africa are excellent for navigating rivers and allows us to quickly ferry troops to where we need them.
effects: Unlocks the ability to Raid over seas, if you can already Raid
Unlocks the ability to sail in Major Rivers
name: West African Canoes

desc: One of the oldest traditional weapons for Indian footmen is the bamboo bow, which is both cheap to make and easy to carry and maintain. Since the bow is also a favorite weapon of many hunters there is no shortage of experienced archers in Indian armies.
name: Bamboo Bow

desc: Based on the authority to command men in battle, the bann gives our rulers the power to compel free men to fight for them, forming a legal basis for the mustering of large armies.
effects: Unlocks the March Contract Vassal Contract
Unlocks the Castellan Contract Vassal Contract
name: Bannus

desc: By constructing dedicated buildings for us to quarter our soldiers in we can make sure that we have sufficient space to accommodate our growing armies.
effects: Unlocks all Tribal Era Military Buildings
name: Barracks

desc: Andalusian stallions are better at traveling and fighting in rough terrain than other breeds of horses. We can train specialized cavalry regiments which take advantage of this.
name: Caballeros

desc: While slow to load and fire, torsion-powered catapults like these allow us to assail enemy fortifications while staying out of their archers' range.
effects: Can recruit Onagers as Men-at-Arms
name: Onager

desc: As with self bows, the strength of a bow's limb determines the potential power of its draw. By reinforcing the span with horn or even steel, the draw-weight and thus range and power of a crossbow can be made magnitudes higher than any wooden counterpart, as well as making it more hard-wearing and longer-lived.
name: Composite Crossbows

parameters.text: May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

unlocks.text: None: crossbowmen men at arms, +5 damage, +5 screen, +0.1 siege value
None: shenbigong men at arms, +5 damage, +5 screen, +0.1 siege value

desc: Elephants are difficult to raise in captivity, so each mahout must capture their own wild elephants and train them. This means there is a delicate art to properly using these great creatures in battle, but it is an art we are dedicated to mastering.
effects: Knights of this Culture become eligible for Elephant Rider Accolades
May recruit Elephant Cavalry Men-at-Arms
name: Elephantry

desc: Meticulous application of certain resins to armors strengthens them considerably, and helps weatherproof heavier iron plates. While this process has been known for some time, its use has been largely limited to boxes, bottles, and other wares. Lacquered armor represents a new way to protect both soldiers and their equipment.
name: Lacquered Armor

parameters.text: Armor Artifacts from Sponsored Inspirations and Commission Artifact are of higher Quality
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: Our longships are formidable seafaring vessels which can travel almost anywhere and even brave rough weather, giving us exceptional mobility on the seas.
effects: Unlocks the ability to Raid over seas, if you can already Raid
Unlocks the ability to sail in Major Rivers
Unlocks the Adventure Raid Intent
name: Longships

desc: Simple yet effective, building our castles on raised earthen mounds is the best way to ensure we quite literally have the high ground over our enemies.
effects: Unlocks all Tribal Era Fortification Buildings
name: Earthworks

parameters.text: If Nomadic, increased chance of Other Effects from Raid Intents

desc: Simply having people willing to fight for us is not enough to win wars. Setting aside space for people to both train and muster for battle will allow us to support groups of more experienced fighters who can lead us to victory.
name: Mustering Grounds

desc: The pole vault, is a simple invention which requires much training and practice to master. A skilled vaulter will be able to propel themselves forward over great gaps and tall rocks, as well as over some fortifications.
name: Pole Vault

desc: Formed of a dozen or more layers of linen stitched together, these jackets can stop even heavy arrows and are an affordable way for us to armor an entire regiment for battle.
effects: Can recruit Armored Footmen as Men-at-Arms
Knights of this Culture become eligible for Vanguard Accolades
name: Quilted Armor

desc: Combining steel-tensioned limbs with mechanical draw systems, these advanced bows extended both range and killing power. The innovation heralded the shift from volume-based defense to precision-focused field deployment, empowering professional armies with tools worthy of empire.
name: Repeating Crossbow

requirements.text: The Repeating Crossbow Innovation is available from the Tribal Era onward

desc: The Sahel is a dry and arid plain, where vast distances are often covered with horses. The Sahel Riders are mounted warriors who use light quilted armor and javelins to devastate their enemies. They are quick and can easily brave deserts and drylands.
name: Sahel Horsemen

desc: Known as Iron Pagodas, these heavily armed cavalrymen were introduced to China by the Jurchen Jin dynasty. Pairing skilled horsemanship with heavy armor, they are a fierce enemy on any battlefield.
name: Tiefutu

desc: What do we owe these lands we live in? Nothing! The realm's heart is its people, and do we not deserve the best soil, the greatest treasures, the finest palaces? Having them is as simple as taking them!
effects: Unlocks the Varangian Adventure Casus Belli during the Tribal Era
name: Varangian Adventurers

desc: Camels are naturally suited for living in desert terrain, but they aren't inherently creatures of battle. Our breeders and trainers can change this, giving us access to adaptive cavalry which will let us master the sands.
effects: Knights of this Culture become eligible for Camelier Accolades
name: War Camels
regionName: the Middle East, Persia or North Africa

desc: Among our people, there is a strong tradition of public gatherings of all free, empowered adults, where anyone may raise their grievances with the ruler. Of course, for those who stand tall in the eyes of the smallfolk, there can be power in swaying the mob...
effects: Characters may break the Crown Authority and Tribal Authority cooldowns at a heavy Prestige cost
Belligerent Vassals are more common
name: All-Things

desc: Using a series of carved wooden blocks, it becomes possible to assemble an array of stamps that can be used several times over to reproduce the same words and images on any suitable material. This vastly simplifies the process of book production, reducing costs and making the written word that much more accessible to everyone.
name: Block Printing

parameters.text: Book Artifact Inspiration Cost: -50%
The Libraries line of Buildings grant additional bonuses
University Visit Study Materials Cost: -50%
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: Might makes right has been the law of the land for generations, but if we have a justification for our wars then we can avoid provoking the ire of our neighbors and the retaliation that often comes with it.
name: Casus Belli

desc: Rice requires an abundance of time and water — except for the rice from Champa. This variety grows faster, survives droughts better, and gives a more bountiful yield than practically any other sort of rice known. In some cases, it can even be harvested twice in one year. Properly managed, this rice can boost farms and fuel a population boom.
name: Champa Rice

parameters.text: May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road
The Wet Fields line of Buildings grant additional bonuses
The Wet Fields and Mansions line of Buildings may be built in Wetlands

desc: By designing our cities before we start constructing them, we can create new holdings in strategic locations which are both more functional and aesthetically pleasing than the older ones which haphazardly arose over time.
name: City Planning

desc: Charcoal is a vital part of smithing, but it needs ample forests nearby in order to reduce wood down into this essential fuel. Coal, heated in something similar to a charcoal kiln, can be reduced down into coke. Coke is just as useful as charcoal in smithing and other industrial fires, without needing to clearcut an entire forest.
name: Coking

parameters.text: The Bloomeries and Crown Blacksmiths lines of Buildings grant additional bonuses
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: By transitioning from the traditional two-field farming model to three-field crop rotation, we can grow more crops each year without depleting the soil on our farms.
effects: Unlocks all Tribal Era Economic Buildings
name: Crop Rotation

desc: Specialized high-temperature furnaces can melt precious metals out of mining samples, extracting them from smelted ores and producing a refined sample that can be further examined by assayers. Cupellating ore from a lead mine is the best way to determine the silver content of that mine, and cupellating gold can determine its purity for potential coinage.
name: Cupellation

parameters.text: May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road
Baronies with Mine Special Building Holding Taxes: 0.15%

desc: Bartering is slow and inefficient; adopting an officially-recognized currency like cowrie shells or metal nuggets will bolster trade and increase the spread of ideas within our realm.
name: Currency

desc: Funding the construction of public works like roads, schools, and aqueducts will allow our settlements to grow to larger sizes, ensuring the prosperity of our people for generations to come.
effects: Counties now reach the maximum Existing Development penalty at 20 Development
name: Public Works

desc: The best porcelain can only be produced at highly-specialized kilns, located near valuable mining deposits. These kilns are built on steep slopes that help create a vortex of heat to fire the hardest ceramics possible. Although challenging to build, the products they make are some of the most fashionable (and the most lucrative) pottery known to any court.
name: Dragon Kilns

parameters.text: Unlocks the Climbing Kiln line of Duchy Buildings, which can be built in mountains, desert mountains, or hills Terrain
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: Stability and prosperity go hand-in-hand. Instead of having vassals jockey for power when the old monarch passes away, we can define a predetermined, equitable system of inheritance which will eliminate much of the instability which traditionally occurs on succession.
name: Gavelkind

desc: As our lands grow, we need a better way to keep track of what we own. Maintaining a ledger of our possessions will ensure that we always know what resources we have at our disposal.
name: Ledger

desc: All good doctors need to know how to produce the right medicines at the right time, using the right ingredients prepared the right way in the right amounts. While this knowledge is often passed down from master to apprentice on an individual basis, writing down how to make specific medicines can help immensely in standardizing and propagating the preparation of different treatments.
name: Pharmacopoeia

parameters.text: Personal Physician Court Position Treatment Effectiveness: +20%
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: In order to effectively govern, we must bring all free men of the realm together to discuss and resolve legislative matters. Attendance is mandatory, and those who do not come will be fined and forfeit their ability to influence any decision made.
name: Plenary Assemblies

desc: The art of silk production is a complex but very rewarding process, the knowledge of which is jealously guarded by those who profit from their mastery of this industry.
name: Sericulture

parameters.text: Unlocks the Mulberry Copse line of Domicile Buildings
Court Fashion Court Amenities Cost: -50%
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: The Table of Princes is the royal seat of Bohemian rulers, with the one sitting at the table being recognized as the rightful ruler. Under the code of house seniority, titles were given to the eldest living member of the ruling dynasty.
effects: Can enact House Seniority at any Crown Authority
name: Table of Princes

desc: Water is the life giver, but has many uses besides quenching thirst or irrigating fields. Artfully harnessed, the sky-fallen resource may power machines many times stronger than any livestock, facilitate travel and trade along man-made canals, or simply keep keep bustling streets sanitary and livable.
name: Waterworks

parameters.text: Unlocks the Man-Made Ponds line of Buildings
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: Also known as Hinduwani or Seric steel, this carbon-rich metal is excellent for making weapons. Wootz steel is widely traded and is deemed the finest steel in the world. Throughout most of history, it has drawn the attention of Arab, Egyptian, Chinese, and even Roman traders.
effects: Unlocks the Wind Furnaces line of Buildings in coastal Holdings in India
name: Wootz Steel

desc: Light cavalry are a force to be reckoned with, but they do not truly exploit the potential of the warhorse. Arched saddles allow us to field heavily armored warriors with couched lances, which lets them take full advantage of their momentum as they charge into enemy lines.
effects: Can recruit Armored Horsemen as Men-at-Arms
Knights of this Culture become eligible for Lancer Accolades
name: Arched Saddle

desc: Beyond fortifying just the keep itself, building a durable outer wall which can be safely manned by our archers will give our castles an extra layer of protection against attackers.
effects: Unlocks all Early Medieval Era Fortification Buildings
Unlocks the Fortification Rights Granted Vassal Contract
name: Battlements

desc: Scattered across the countryside, the best mustering grounds and administrative centers are protected by solid walls of stone.
effects: Unlocks all Early Medieval Era Military Buildings
name: Stone Forts

desc: Plumbing the mysteries of life can sometimes uncover things that create only death. Fire medicine, a potent combination of sulfur, saltpeter, and some burnable material, creates a deadly flame that burns fiercely, almost explosively.
name: Fire Medicine

parameters.text: May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road
Can recruit Fire Lancers as Men-at-Arms
Unlocks the Powder Storehouse line of Buildings

desc: Slave-soldiers taken as prisoners of war, ghilman are dedicated fighters who are both more loyal to us and cheaper to pay than common mercenaries.
name: Ghilman

desc: Despite all the advancements in warfare, one ancient tool remains invaluable: the arm. Small vessels filled with a flammable or explosive substance can be easily made and thrown by anyone with a decent pitching technique. Grenades distributed to soldiers before a battle can give them a secondary way to attack and shock the enemy.
name: Grenades

parameters.text: May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: A horse with a split hoof will quickly go lame and be unable to work or be ridden into battle. By shoeing our horses with bronze or iron plates, we can keep their hooves healthy and protected from damage.
name: Horseshoes

desc: As our noble families grow in power, they need soldiers to enforce their will. Establishing an order of dedicated household soldiers will ensure that we have troops which are better trained and equipped than a standard levy.
name: Household Soldiers

desc: A significant improvement to our existing catapult designs, traction-powered mangonels are much faster to load and fire than torsion-powered machines.
effects: Can recruit Mangonels as Men-at-Arms
Knights of this Culture become eligible for Besieger Accolades
name: Mangonels

desc: Distracted by infighting, we have tolerated the presence of infidels in Hispania for too long. The time has come for us to rally our forces to drive them from this land once and for all!
effects: Casus Belli Piety Cost: -10%
Zealot Vassals are more common
name: Spiritual Expansionism

desc: These large mural instruments can be used to precisely read and measure the position of heavenly objects.

Characters: +0.2 Character Capital County Monthly Development Growth Add /month

name: Mural Sextant

desc: Comprised of a spherical framework of moving rings, these devices allow us to chart and predict the movement of the heavens. While a fascinating astrological device in its own right, this knowledge will also help aid our captains when navigating waters far from land.
name: Armillary Sphere

desc: A ruler cannot be everywhere at once. By appointing magistrates and other representatives to enforce the lord's law throughout the realm, we can govern a larger area more effectively than we could otherwise.
effects: Glory Hound Vassals are more common
name: Magistrates

desc: The surest way to prevent a ship from sinking is to not breach its hull in the first place. But if that were to happen, the ship might still be saved if the hull was separated into compartments with watertight walls between them. Even if the ship was damaged, a bulkhead could prevent water from sinking the ship entirely, saving men, supplies, and the ship itself in the process.
name: Bulkheads

parameters.text: May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: No more will the stories of our family's exploits be passed down just through oral tradition. We will keep a record of all that we accomplish, both to inspire future generations as well as to prove our claims over lands we should rightfully hold.
effects: Can press several of your Claims in a single war
Casus Belli Prestige Cost: -10%
Zealot Vassals are more common
name: Chronicle Writing

desc: With a piece of simple lodestone, it becomes possible to always know what direction a person is traveling in. With time and further development, it may eventually become possible to navigate without ever having to stop and ask someone for directions.
name: Compass

parameters.text: Adventure Inspiration Cost: -50%
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: Unregulated currencies are difficult to control and lack stability. Minted coins, measured to specific weights and stamped with a royal seal, give new confidence to commercial transactions.
effects: Unlocks the Coinage Rights Granted Vassal Contract
name: Coinage

desc: Larger towns regularly face a series of increasingly complex problems. Delegating some authority to local councils will let them resolve these issues without needing to get the king involved.
effects: Counties now reach the maximum Existing Development penalty at 35 Development
name: Communal Government

desc: Records must keep up with the growing complexity of finances and the economy. Recording all payments in and all payments out as separate records helps maintain reliable balance sheets and ensure that entries aren't accidentally — or "accidentally" — overlooked when reviewing accounts.
name: Double-Entry Bookkeeping

parameters.text: Collect Taxes Councillor Task: +10%
May only be acquired as a potential Cultural Fascination via Chinese Heritage, the Sinophilic Tradition, or the Silk Road

desc: Evenly dividing the realm amongst all eligible heirs fractures the unity of our people. Instead of tearing our realm asunder on every succession we can ensure we have a stable and prosperous heartland by establishing a system of hereditary rule.
name: Hereditary Rule

desc: With land ownership consolidated under our elite, many men and women find themselves unable to work. We will establish a manor system where free men can work our fields in exchange for rent, while those who cannot pay may enter our service as bound serfs instead.
effects: Unlocks all Early Medieval Era Economic Buildings
Parochial Vassals are more common
name: Manorialism

desc: As our royalty has a greater burden placed upon them by their responsibility to govern the realm, so too shall they be bestowed with privileges reserved exclusively for them.
effects: Courtly Vassals are more common
name: Royal Prerogative

desc: Despite coming from different tribes, we recognize the importance of unity and cooperation. Independence is overvalued when stability is what leads to safety and prosperity.
effects: Vassals whose Culture has a shared Heritage with yours are less likely to join Independence Factions
name: Stammesherzogtum

desc: While archers have traditionally made and maintained their own bows, craftsmen have begun making new types of bows which are stronger and more complex than before. By embracing these new designs we can turn these master bowyers into an invaluable military asset.
effects: Can recruit Crossbowmen as Men-at-Arms
Knights of this Culture become eligible for Crossbow Captain Accolades
name: Advanced Bowmaking

desc: While the keep serves as the heart of a castle, it is far from the only important building. Constructing buildings like the stables and armory in a protected bailey will ensure we can properly garrison and equip our levies no matter the circumstances.
effects: Unlocks all High Medieval Era Military Buildings
name: Castle Baileys

desc: The Levant is an unfamiliar place with poor terrain for cavalry charges. We should adapt to these lands and field cavalry which is better suited to fight in our new home.
name: Desert Tactics

desc:
Placed on the top of our battlements, these wooden constructions extend out above the base of our castle walls.

They allow our defenders to fire arrows, drop stones, or pour boiling oil on attackers while remaining completely protected from enemy archers.
effects: Unlocks all High Medieval Era Fortification Buildings
name: Hoardings

desc: Riders on our Celtic hobby horses are both fast and agile — perfect for scouting and raiding in rough terrain where enemy knights are loathe to go.
name: Hobbies

desc: By bestowing knighthoods upon our best fighters and paying them with land holdings instead of mere coin, we can give them the honor they deserve as well as secure their loyalty to us.
effects: Children completing their Education with a Martial Education Focus gain a Students of Knighthood Trait
Glory Hound Vassals are more common
name: Knighthood

desc: Training and equipping standing armies that remain under the direct disposal of our rulers will be a stepping stone on the road to centralize our power.
name: Men-at-Arms

desc: Pikemen have always been strong defenders, but they have historically lacked in mobility and offense. Devising new formations to address this deficiency will improve our chances of victory in battle.
name: Pike Columns

requirements.text: The Pike Columns Innovation becomes available in the High Medieval Era

desc: The highlands where our ancestors settled requires a particular approach to agriculture. The building of terraced fields taught us to develop new military tactics, which are employed by our Serawit soldiers.
name: Sarawit

requirements.text: The Sarawit Innovation becomes available in the High Medieval Era

desc: An engineering marvel, the counterweight trebuchet can hurl heavy projectiles at distances further than any siege engine that came before it.
effects: Can recruit Trebuchets as Men-at-Arms
name: Trebuchet

desc: Particularly large or expensive trades often require an unwieldy amount of heavy coinage. Depositing that wealth in secure treasuries and transferring ownership without moving the physical coins will allow large quantities of goods to be traded more easily.
name: Banking

desc: The great cities of Rome, Byzantium, and Delhi have long stood out as relics of a great, unmatchable legacy. As our infrastructure and population grow, we finally have the means to develop new settlements which rival these ancient urban centers.
effects: Counties now reach the maximum Existing Development penalty at 55 Development
name: Urbanization

desc: It is time that we recognize that it is divine will that has placed our rulers on their thrones, and to oppose them is to oppose divinity itself.
effects: Can press multiple Claims for another character in a single war
Unlocks the Palatinate Contract Vassal Contract
Zealot Vassals are more common
name: Divine Right

desc: The lands to our east are sparsely inhabited, but rich in natural resources. Establishing an initiative to expand and establish homesteads there will lead to the growth and prosperity of our people.
effects: Promote Culture Councillor Task Speed: +15%
name: Ostsiedlung

desc: By rightfully recognizing the most illustrious amongst the noble vassals of our realm we will foster a sentiment of greater loyalty towards the crown.
name: Peerage

desc: As our lands expand it becomes increasingly inefficient to directly manage all trade going on within our domain. By granting guild charters to organizations of merchants and craftsmen we can give them more autonomy over their businesses while still ensuring we profit from their ventures.
effects: Unlocks all High Medieval Era Economic Buildings
name: Guilds

desc: Establishing hereditary designs to identify our noble families will cause their members to see themselves as part of a greater whole, encouraging them to improve their dynasty's reputation instead of merely being obsessed with personal status.
effects: Courtly Vassals are more common
name: Heraldry

desc: Land is the most valuable reward we can bestow upon our subjects, but there is only so much that we directly own. However, if we were to grant them permission to start farming that unworked land over there... who would object? Even if conflict does result, we will clearly be in the right when we defend our subjects!
effects: Fabricate Claim on County Councillor Task Speed: +50%
Casus Belli Prestige Cost: -10%
Parochial Vassals are more common
name: Land Grants

desc: Wars, raids, and persecution all over the world have driven many people from their homes. By welcoming these displaced souls to our lands regardless of their background we can develop a rich and prosperous society.
name: Muladi

desc: Cleanliness is paramount, and investment in the civic engineering required to provide all with the ability to maintain appropriate levels of hygiene is extremely important to our people.
name: Sanitation

desc: Military service has always been expected of our subjects, but there are some who are unable or unwilling to provide it. By offering a way for them to meet their obligations with coin instead of steel, we can ensure that we get our dues from everyone.
effects: Unlocks the Scutage Contract Vassal Contract
name: Scutage

desc: By delegating more responsibilities to local nobles, we can both make them happy as well as freeing up more of our attention to focus on our own domain.
name: Seigneurialism

desc: The invention of the vertical windmill allows us to harness the power of the wind much more efficiently than before, vastly reducing the labor necessary to grind grains and process raw materials.
name: Windmills

desc: Weapons like the goedendag are cheap and easy to produce, yet surprisingly effective against cavalry charges. Their existence allows us to adapt our militias to have much better odds when fighting armored knights.
name: Adaptive Militia

requirements.text: The Adaptive Militia Innovation becomes available in the Late Medieval Era

desc: Being both wealthy and centrally located, Italy has become a major center for mercenary companies to travel to when not on active campaign. Since they are already here, we should be able to negotiate a better rate for them than they would normally charge.
name: Condottieri

desc: The development of explosive powders has created new breeds of weapons, and new types of warriors to use them. Fielding these potent guns requires production and supply chains uncalled for in the past, but cost of these works pays for itself with the might unlocked by this new technology.
effects: Can recruit Bombards as Men-at-Arms
name: Gunpowder

parameters.text: Can recruit Handgunners as Men-at-Arms
Unlocks the Powder Storehouse line of Buildings

desc: Just as we have restored the Roman empire, so too shall restore the structure of the old Roman legion and its feared elite troops!
name: Legionnaires

requirements.text: Rules a restored Roman Empire (not Byzantium)

desc: A notable improvement on our earlier hoardings, stone machicolations serve the same purpose while being significantly more durable and offering more protection for our defenders.
effects: Unlocks all Late Medieval Era Fortification Buildings
name: Machicolations

desc: The ultimate form of personal protection, a well-crafted suit of plate armor has articulated joints which give it a superior range of motion to earlier armors, while being all but impenetrable to enemy weapons.
name: Plate Armor

desc: The traditional pike circle is a powerful defensive formation, but it is limited in offense and mobility. While requiring great discipline to employ, our rectilinear schiltron is a superior formation which is capable of both powerful offensive and defensive tactics.
name: Rectilinear Schiltron

requirements.text: The Rectilinear Schiltron Innovation becomes available in the Late Medieval Era

desc: Using explosive formulas cruder than anything needed by expensive bombards, massive volleys of fire arrows can be fired from a single device. Since these fire arrows still only have the impact of... an arrow, they are far better-suited for shooting from walls than at them.
name: Rocket Carts

desc: As the size of our armies increases, we must guarantee that each and every soldier will be properly armed and armored. The establishment of a royal armory to produce and house all of our armies' equipment will go a long way towards meeting this need.
effects: Unlocks all Late Medieval Era Military Buildings
name: Royal Armory

desc: It does not matter how strong our enemy's walls are if the earth beneath them can be dug through. Employing sappers to undermine enemy fortifications is an effective way to breach even the toughest defenses.
name: Sappers

desc: Military levies provide us with large numbers of soldiers, yet no matter how well we try to train and equip them they will always be inferior to professional soldiers. Establishing a large standing army will ensure the interests of our realm are enforced by the best fighters around.
effects: Belligerent Vassals are more common
name: Standing Armies

desc: Establishing a valet system of dedicated servants for our noble horsemen will enable us to field knights who are both better armed and armored.
name: Valets

requirements.text: The Valets Innovation becomes available in the Late Medieval Era

desc: These massive two-handed swords are as adept at cutting down charging knights as they are at breaking enemy pike formations, making them a formidable addition to our own pike regiments.
name: Zweihanders

desc: Beautiful stone pottery in the image of eastern porcelain, by mixing in materials such as quartz or glass. They make for valuable merchandise, or impressive gifts.
effects: Opinion Gain from Send Gift: +20%
name: Fritware

desc: Our realm has expanded to the point where even minor nobles cannot administer everything effectively. Appointing court officials and bureaucrats to handle the more mundane court tasks will ensure that the wheels of government continue turning smoothly.
effects: Courtly Vassals are more common
name: Court Officials

desc: A forgotten marvel of engineering, the Romans used tread-wheel cranes to great effect when building their empire, and so too shall we.
effects: Unlocks all Late Medieval Era Economic Buildings
name: Cranes

desc: An evolution of earlier banking systems, paper promissory notes allow our citizens to quickly and safely trade goods and services across large distances without being weighed down by heavy specie.
name: Promissory Notes

desc: The influx of new beliefs and religions into our society has made it clear that our past focus on regionalism has been a mistake. We should band together with others of our faith and ensure a strong and enduring state that can stand up to external pressures.
name: Deccan Unity

desc: Developments in science, philosophy, and logic have turned our cities into wondrous centers of education and innovation. The massive technological and cultural leaps we are now making has put hitherto undreamed potential within our grasp.
effects: Counties now reach the maximum Existing Development penalty at 90 Development
Parochial Vassals are more common
name: Renaissance Thought

desc: Anyone may claim a title, but in order to be a true monarch they must inspire awe and majesty in their subjects. Using the most rare and exotic materials in our regal clothing is sure to accomplish just that.
name: Exotic Regalia

desc: Nobility is more than just privileges and rights; it also comes with a duty to the realm, an obligation to act in ways that are proper and just. Clearly establishing what is expected from our elite will give us an ideal to aspire to and bring us together as we work to achieve it.
name: Noblesse Oblige

desc: One kingdom, one heir. While the younger children of our monarch may feel forsaken by being denied an inheritance, this is the best way to ensure we keep a stable realm which does not get torn apart by succession crises.
effects: Zealot Vassals are more common
name: Primogeniture

desc: It is our divine right to possess our de jure lands, and it is time the world recognizes this fact. No longer will we be held back by obsolete protocols and decorum.
effects: Casus Belli Prestige Cost: -10%
Glory Hound Vassals are more common
name: Rightful Ownership

desc: Building strong and reliable dikes is an essential task if we wish to live and prosper within the low countries. New techniques of reinforcing earthen dikes with seaweed mats will increase their strength and durability.
name: Wierdijks
